AllowPlayerPortraitChanges.Name: Allow players to activate accessible variants
AllowPlayerPortraitChanges.Hint: Players may activate for everyone variants which the GM has made available to them.

AllowOwnerVariantConfiguration.Name: Allow owners to configure portrait variants
AllowOwnerVariantConfiguration.Hint: Actor owners may create, edit, and delete variants available to them. Hidden GM variants and privileged settings are not shown.

AttentionRequests.Name: Allow players to request GM attention
AttentionRequests.Hint: Shows a hand button on the assigned character's portrait. The request appears in chat for GMs and that player.

AttentionDefaultZone.Name: Default focus zone for requests
AttentionDefaultZone.Hint: On acceptance, a request goes directly to this zone when available. Otherwise the GM chooses placement.

AttentionReplaceOccupied.Name: Skip confirmation when replacing an occupied zone
AttentionReplaceOccupied.Hint: After a GM accepts a request, an occupied zone may be replaced without another confirmation. The request still needs GM approval.

DebugLogging.Name: Debug logging
DebugLogging.Hint: Write additional RN Portrait Stage diagnostic information to the browser console.

ExperimentalVoiceEnabled.Name: Use voice activation on this client (experimental)
ExperimentalVoiceEnabled.Hint: Locally enables experimental microphone activity detection when allowed by the GM. No audio is transmitted or recorded.

ExperimentalVoiceAllowed.Name: Allow voice activation (experimental)
ExperimentalVoiceAllowed.Hint: Allows users to use local microphone activity detection for portraits. This feature remains experimental.

VoiceThreshold.Name: Voice activation threshold
VoiceThreshold.Hint: Minimum microphone signal level treated as speech. Lower it when phrase beginnings are missed; raise it when background noise triggers the portrait.

VoiceAttack.Name: Voice indication attack delay
VoiceAttack.Hint: How many milliseconds the signal must remain above the threshold before activating the portrait.

VoiceRelease.Name: Voice indication release delay
VoiceRelease.Hint: How many milliseconds of silence are required before deactivating the portrait.

PortraitScale.Name: Personal portrait scale
PortraitScale.Hint: Scales the GM-defined portrait sizes on this client.

FocusScale.Name: Personal focus scale
FocusScale.Hint: Adjusts the width of the focus portrait group on this client.

BackgroundDefaultFit.Name: Default background fit
BackgroundDefaultFit.Hint: Fit mode assigned to newly added backgrounds. Existing backgrounds keep their own setting.

InitialActorVariant.Name: Initial actor portrait variant
InitialActorVariant.Hint: Variant used when first adding an Actor to the cast, reserve, or focus. Existing portraits and saved Actor selections do not change.

HoverArtDefaultSource.Name: Default enlarged hover art
HoverArtDefaultSource.Hint: The enlarged-art source used by variants which inherit the world setting.

FocusImageDefaultSource.Name: Default focus image
FocusImageDefaultSource.Hint: Image source in scene focus when the variant does not override it.

HoverArtBottomOffset.Name: Enlarged art bottom offset
HoverArtBottomOffset.Hint: World-space distance between enlarged hover art and the bottom edge of the screen, in pixels.

HoverArtWorldScale.Name: Enlarged art size
HoverArtWorldScale.Hint: Base world scale for enlarged art. Variant and personal client scales are applied in addition.

HoverArtScale.Name: Personal enlarged-art scale
HoverArtScale.Hint: Scales enlarged hover art on this client only.

TokenHighlightEnabled.Name: Highlight visible tokens on hover
TokenHighlightEnabled.Hint: Shared setting for highlighting visible tokens when a portrait is hovered. Changes apply immediately for all players.

ImageHoverPriority.Name: Image Hover compatibility
ImageHoverPriority.Hint: Choose which close-up art is shown when RN Portrait Stage token highlighting also triggers Image Hover.

LitmIntegrationEnabled.Name: Enable litm-rn integration
LitmIntegrationEnabled.Hint: Adds a tag visibility action and displays Actor tags and statuses on portrait hover.

LabelFontFamily.Name: Portrait label font
LabelFontFamily.Hint: Portrait label font from the fonts available in this world.

StageEnabled.Name: Show portraits to everyone
StageEnabled.Hint: Controlled by the GM from the cast manager. While disabled, portraits are not rendered for any user.

PersistentState.Name: Persistent portrait cast
PersistentState.Hint: Internal storage for portraits which remain visible between Scenes.

ReserveActors.Name: Actor reserve
ReserveActors.Hint: Internal world storage for Actors prepared for quick cast placement.

PreviewSession.Name: Preview draft
PreviewSession.Hint: Local internal storage for the GM preview draft.

CastPresets.Name: Cast presets
CastPresets.Hint: Internal world storage for cast presets.

PortraitGap.Name: Portrait spacing
PortraitGap.Hint: World-level gap between portraits in pixels, controlled by the GM.

FocusGap.Name: Focus portrait spacing
FocusGap.Hint: Gap between focus slots in pixels, shared with all players. Negative values overlap portraits.

PcOffsetX.Name: Character group horizontal offset
PcOffsetX.Hint: Move the character portrait group horizontally, in pixels.

PcOffsetY.Name: Character group vertical offset
PcOffsetY.Hint: Move the character portrait group vertically, in pixels.

NpcOffsetX.Name: NPC group horizontal offset
NpcOffsetX.Hint: Move the NPC portrait group horizontally, in pixels.

NpcOffsetY.Name: NPC group vertical offset
NpcOffsetY.Hint: Move the NPC portrait group vertically, in pixels.

VariantGroups.Hint: Groups organize variant selection and may be hidden from players. Variants in a hidden group are hidden too.
